name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.pointsOver_nonempty_of_killsCokernel
summary: Lift p^κE^s·constantAt(c) to x with the standard exponents of level 0 and divide by E^s.

steps.claim: By exists_lift_of_mem_liftIdeal (hK, modulus 0) for constantAt(S, i)(c) ∈ locLetterPart(trivLattice(S), 0, i): x ∈ kisinLoc(Ỹ) (m) with the standard exponents of level 0 at i (t) and projTriv(S)(x) = p^κE^s·constantAt(S, i)(c) (e).

E^{−s}·x is a point over p^κc: in kisinLoc (frobEUnit_zpow_smul_mem_kisinLoc), with image p^κ·constantAt(c), with exponents raisedAtE(−s) (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 (−s)), and its Galois differences have them too (smul_sub_mem_withExponents).
steps.lean:
⟨_, frobEUnit_zpow_smul_mem_kisinLoc.2
    m, by simp [e, inv_smul_eq_iff, frobEUnit_pow_smul, frobE_eq]; module,
    frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 (-s) t,
    smul_sub_mem_withExponents (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents _ _ t)⟩
